suggestions.reason: Assertion 6 ('explains how to register the new detector') is satisfied by the plan having a Task 3 with registration code. A tighter version would check that the plan specifically names FormatDetectorStrategy.create_default() as the registration point, since a plan that just says 'register it somewhere' would also pass.

No assertion checks that the plan documents the ordering sensitivity of detector registration (Froala registered before SEA may affect detection for hybrid documents). The plan does mention this in Edge Cases but no eval assertion covers it. A plan that silently omits ordering concerns would pass all assertions.

eval_feedback.overall: All 9 assertions pass with strong evidence. The format-detector eval is the most comprehensive in this iteration. Minor gaps: registration specificity and ordering sensitivity are not asserted.
